independentReview.source: Independent visual-ralph result supplied in the task; persisted here, not a new review performed by this documentation update
limits: Not pixel parity or a calibrated pixel-diff score
No live AX interaction or VoiceOver audit claimed
No TCC verification, permission prompt or TCC bypass claimed
Visual PASS is not accessibility sign-off or an overall gate including AX

captureMetadataPolicy: capture.json and window.json visualPass remain false as unchanged capture-time metadata, not the subsequent independent visual-only verdict. Capture metadata has no established independent visual-threshold contract. The outstanding-review wording in window.json describes capture time; this artifact records the later review without asserting an overall gate including AX has passed.
verificationScope: Documentation-only persistence; no new review, capture, build, test run or accessibility audit. Existing reproduction commands not rerun. Image dimensions and saved hashes checked; git diff --check run.
